pages.title: A magazine for the time you spend waiting
pages.lead: Falmouth already gathers in waiting rooms, hotel lobbies, the Chamber, and the library. This magazine is for that time.
paragraphs: Falmouth Wellness Discovery is a quarterly health and wellness magazine with a fold-out discovery map. We print 1,000 copies and place them free. Winter 2027 is the founding issue, and this digital reader is a sample of that issue.
The pages follow four pillars: Mind, Body, Soul, and Health & Food. Stories are written from interviews. Until someone confirms a fact, the page says so. Placeholder businesses are marked as samples.

The printed magazine is letter size, made from 11×17 sheets. Tear out the walking-map sheet: the front is the wellness map, with partner boxes around the edge, and the back is a Falmouth visitor guide. On a wide screen those two sides open as landscape spreads.
Come by Cape Island Café at 316 Gifford Street if you want to talk about a story or a partnership. The phone is (774) 247-5263 and the email is CapeIslandCafe@gmail.com.

pages.title: Tanorama, nearly three decades on Main Street
pages.dek: Sample layout for the Issue 1 feature. The interview with owner Scott is still to come.
paragraphs: Tanorama is a tanning salon at 365 Main Street, Falmouth. Owner Scott has kept the business on Main Street for nearly three decades. That is the confirmed frame of the story.

This sample spread shows where the interview will sit: how the shop fits the winter town, who comes in, and what Scott wants readers to know. Services beyond tanning are not listed here, because they have not been confirmed for this page.
The finished story will run beside the salon's own ad, after Scott signs off on the words.

pages.pullquote: Sample pull quote from the interview goes here.
paragraphs: The quote above is a placeholder, the same one used in the pitch layout. It is not something Scott said.

When the conversation happens, this page can hold a short timeline, a portrait, and a way to find the salon on the discovery map. The map pin for Tanorama is already at 365 Main Street, because that address is confirmed.
Until then, treat every sentence on these two pages as a sample frame, except the address, the owner's name, and the nearly-three-decades line.

The menu, prices, and any hours beyond weekday lunch are not printed here. They will come from the café. Readers can call (774) 247-5263 or write to CapeIslandCafe@gmail.com.

pages.title: Police, fire, Town Hall, Chamber
pages.dek: Winter 2027 notes are not in yet. The frame is here.
paragraphs: Each quarter these four desks can send a short 'what's happening' note. Issue 1 does not invent one. For emergencies, call 911.

Falmouth Police Department is listed in OpenStreetMap at 750 Main Street. Falmouth Fire-Rescue publishes its stations through the town; this page does not treat one station as the only firehouse. Town Hall is at 59 Town Hall Square. The Falmouth Chamber of Commerce is on Katherine Lee Bates Road, and its public page is on the Cape Cod Chamber site.
The town website is falmouthma.gov. That is the place for hours and non-emergency numbers. We are not copying them into a quarterly that will sit in a lobby after they change.

trails.name: Shining Sea Bikeway
trails.detail: 10.7 miles, from County Road in North Falmouth (off this sheet) to the Steamship Authority terminal in Woods Hole. This cell is the Depot Avenue parking access in the village. Named for Katharine Lee Bates. A monument stands on the path near Woods Hole and Oyster Pond; it is not pinned on this sheet. From Depot Avenue the town describes a trail toward Highfield Hall and Beebe Woods, and another toward Goodwill Park, Grew’s Pond, Long Pond, and the Moraine Trail, crossing Route 28.
